page.layout: One text column; marginal note block in the left margin beside the upper-middle lines. Running head and page number at the top. Catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: Et cùm istuc quoque ab Alberto legati de
ipsum profecti, se & totam illam Orien-
hodie censetur, ei tradiderunt hac lege,
ut eandem in feudum ab ipso mox reci-
vero fecêre, cum faciendi ejus jus omnino
nullum haberent. Cùm his idem fecêre
quidam in agro hoc Groningano, nume-
ri, Haijo Wibenius, quorum animi jam-
studio prurierant: à quibus totus inter
æquo & bono divisus, ac Alberto datus,
ab Alberto verò ipsis in feudum redditus.

marginalia.note: Pactio quorundam è nobilitate cum Alberto Bavaro contra libertatem patriæ.

page.notes: The left margin note is set in small italic type and runs over several lines; it is transcribed as one note at the point beside "Folcmarus". The first word "Amalum" is read with some doubt (possible tilde over the u). The running head and page number are read as printed. The catchword "taque" is printed at the lower right and is not repeated in the text.
